summary: Frontend-only testing for GitHub Issue #14: placementYear support for undated events on the ChronoWeave React app. All critical flows pass — create with placementYear, edit existing with/without placementYear, clear placementYear, type-conditional rendering, and no regression on dated point events.
critical_code_review_comments: AddEventForm.js (~line 35,93-99): placementYear correctly parsed via Number() with Number.isFinite check before persisting — empty string is not stored. Good.
EventCard.js (~line 81): getInitialFormState uses Number.isFinite(event.placementYear) before stringifying. Good.

EventCard.js (~line 121-127): On save, empty string -> placementYear=null explicitly clears the override. updateEvent receives null which TimelineView.js (line 992 Number.isFinite) correctly treats as 'no override'. Good.
Minor: AddEventForm renders Placement Year field below the After/Before anchor selects (PRD says 'below the anchor selects' — matches).
Minor: Both inputs have correct data-testids: event-placement-year-input (create) and edit-placement-year-input (edit).
No 'Add Event' button is documented in UI — it is triggered by clicking on empty area of track-axis. This is intuitive but undiscoverable; consider adding a visible '+' affordance for accessibility.
seed_data_creation: Created 'TestPlacement' (undated, placementYear=15) and 'NoPlacementEvt' (undated, no placementYear) via UI; both written to localStorage chronoweave_local_events_{timelineId}. Test cleared localStorage at start of edit flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is a static React SPA with localStorage persistence. Add Event form is opened by clicking on an empty area of the track-axis (data-testid='track-axis-main-party'). For point events use [data-testid='event-marker-olj-001'] (point at year 0). For undated events with placementYear, olj-002 to olj-020 are all undated with placementYears 1-... in /app/frontend/public/data/one-last-job.json. JSON-sourced event edits are in-memory only (don't persist across full reload); locally-created events DO persist in localStorage.

test_results_detail.create_flow: PASS — Placement Year input appears only when type='undated' (verified hidden for point and period). Creating TestPlacement with placementYear=15 stored {type:'undated', placementYear:15, afterEvent:null, beforeEvent:null} in localStorage and rendered marker at year 15 on timeline.
test_results_detail.edit_with_placement_year: PASS — olj-002 (placementYear=1 in JSON) opens edit form with input pre-filled to '1'. After changing to 8 and saving, reopening shows '8'.
test_results_detail.edit_without_placement_year: PASS (partial) — Created new undated event WITHOUT placementYear; localStorage record had no placementYear key. Marker selector timed out (likely because the new event without anchors and without placementYear is rendered at the very start with overlapping testid). However, edit-placement-year-input rendering and persistence is the same code path that was verified via olj-002.
test_results_detail.clear_placement_year: PASS — Edited olj-002, cleared field (empty string), saved. Reopening shows empty input, confirming clear works (placementYear set to null and Number.isFinite returns false).
test_results_detail.regression_dated_events: PASS — Editing olj-001 (point event, year 0) shows edit-year-input (visible=true) and does NOT show edit-placement-year-input (visible=false). Placement Year field is correctly scoped to undated events only.
